evals.prompt: Review the order and payment logic in evals/files/sample-repo and tell me whether it actually does the right thing. Draw the order state machine and list any transitions that should not be possible.
evals.expected_output: A Mermaid stateDiagram for OrderStatus showing Pending->Paid, Pending/Paid->Cancelled, Paid->Shipped, and an illegal Cancelled->Paid (and Refunded->Paid) edge via OrderService.Pay; a rules table; a High BIZ finding for the missing status guard in Pay; a High/Medium finding for the double converted to double amount passed to the gateway; Ship() and StockService recorded as verified (not flagged); a 'Flows not fully traced' list; findings written to audit/findings/audit-business-logic.json.
expectations: Output contains a mermaid stateDiagram-v2 block for the order flow
A finding with id prefix BIZ- flags OrderService.Pay for allowing Cancelled (terminal) orders to become Paid, rated High or Critical
A finding flags the (double)order.Total conversion in OrderService.Pay as money on a floating-point type
OrderService.Ship is listed as a verified rule, not a finding
StockService.Reserve is not reported as a business-rule finding; the check-then-decrement race is handed off to audit-concurrency-and-race-condition
OrderLine.WeightKg (double) is not flagged as money
Report contains a 'Flows not fully traced' or 'Not checked' section

evals.prompt: Can a customer get the same coupon applied more than once in evals/files/sample-repo? Audit the discount logic.
evals.expected_output: A High BIZ finding on PricingService.ApplyCoupon / OrdersController.ApplyCoupon: Total is decremented in place with no check on AppliedCouponCode and SingleUse is never enforced, so a repeated POST subtracts the discount twice; remediation derives Total from Subtotal minus a single recorded coupon; ComputeSubtotal noted as correct; a sequence diagram of the coupon flow.
expectations: A BIZ- finding rated High identifies that ApplyCoupon subtracts from order.Total on every call with no guard
The finding mentions that Coupon.SingleUse is not enforced
Remediation says to derive the total from line items and a single recorded coupon rather than mutate Total
Output contains a mermaid sequenceDiagram for the coupon flow

evals.prompt: We are about to go live. Do a business logic audit of evals/files/sample-repo and write the report to audit/reports/audit-business-logic.md.
evals.expected_output: Full report in the skill's output template: summary table, one section per flow (orders/payments, discounts, inventory) with state and sequence diagrams and a rules table, findings for Cancelled->Paid and the double coupon application, a 'Handed off' table naming audit-concurrency-and-race-condition for the stock check-then-act, and a 'Flows not fully traced' list; audit/status/audit-business-logic.json written with status completed.
expectations: Report has sections per flow each containing a mermaid diagram and a rules table
Report contains a 'Handed off' table that names audit-concurrency-and-race-condition for StockService.Reserve
Both planted issues (illegal Cancelled->Paid transition, coupon applied twice) appear as findings
audit/status/audit-business-logic.json is written with status completed
No file outside audit/ is modified
